title: Years After Announcement, Netflix's Assassin's Creed TV Series Finally Begins Production
author: Push Square
summary: Netflix's long-anticipated *Assassin's Creed* TV series has finally begun production in Rome, Italy, after being announced over five years ago. The show will feature an original storyline set in 64 AD, focusing on the conflict between two factions vying for control over humanity's future. This development is significant as it marks a major step forward for the adaptation, which has been eagerly awaited by fans of the franchise.
